anomalies.observed: The schematic/netlist value and library part identify these buffers as SN74LVC1G07QDCKTQ1, but the MPN field for every one of them is U74LVC1G125G-AL5-R (UTC), which is a different buffer type.
anomalies.expected: The specification requires SN74LVC1G07 buffers for these functions, so the sourced part number should match SN74LVC1G07 or the design value should be corrected to the actual intended part.

evidence.quote: U15 | SN74LVC1G07QDCKTQ1 | Package_TO_SOT_SMD:SOT-353_SC-70-5 | acorn-motherboard:SN74LVC1G07QDCKTQ1 |  | Digikey=TC7SH34FULJ(CTCT-ND, MPN=U74LVC1G125G-AL5-R, LCSC=C171458, Manufacturer=UTC(Unisonic Tech)
single non-inverting buffers (`SN74LVC1G07`, parts `U15`, `U22`, `U35`, `U36`) wired as `/OE`-controlled sinks

anomalies.impact: SN74LVC1G07 is an open-drain buffer, while SN74LVC1G125 is a push-pull 3-state buffer. If the board is assembled from the MPN field, the e-stop sinks, power-switch drivers, and LED drivers will not behave as the specified open-drain /OE-controlled sinks.

anomalies.observed: The net /LED_3.3V_POWER_SW contains only the anodes of D4, D14, and D23; it has no connection to +3V3, /LED_3.3V_POWER_NONINV, or any other supply/switch.
anomalies.expected: LED anodes that feed Ethernet and Pi activity LEDs through series resistors to open-collector outputs should be connected to a 3.3 V LED supply net.
anomalies.impact: D4, D14, and D23 cannot light because their anodes are floating, removing the intended Pi activity and Ethernet link/activity indications.

anomalies.observed: Both GND1 and GND2 pins of the isolated CAN transceivers are tied to the same common GND net.
anomalies.expected: For the specified isolated CAN buses, GND1 and GND2 should be separate isolated ground nets so the transceiver isolation barrier is effective.

evidence.quote: GND [High Power] : ... U10.4(GND1,power_in) U10.5(GND2,power_in) U11.4(GND1,power_in) U11.5(GND2,power_in) ...
two isolated CAN buses (`CAN0`, `CAN1`), each driven by its own MCP2515 SPI CAN controller (`U8`, `U9`) through an isolated CAN transceiver (`U11`/companion)

anomalies.impact: The galvanic isolation of the CAN transceivers is defeated; bus-side faults or ground offsets can couple into the CM4/CAN-controller side.
